topics.name: Prompt Templates
notes: - 把提示词写成带变量的模板，便于复用和测试。
- prompt.invoke 只负责格式化，返回 ChatPromptValue，不会调用模型。
- 用 | 把模板和模型组合成 Runnable 链。

topics.name: Structured Output
topics.description: Getting schema-conforming results from a model.
notes: - 让模型按预先定义的 schema 返回数据，而不是自由文本。
- 返回值已解析并校验为 Person 对象，无需手动解析 JSON。
- 字段名和描述会影响模型填写效果，应写清楚字段含义。

questions.title: In ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages, what is the purpose of the ("system", ...) entry?

options.text: It sets instructions and behavior for the model
It stores the user's input
It holds the model's reply
It registers a tool

questions.explanation: The system message carries standing instructions such as role and rules. User input goes into a human message.

questions.title: Which operator composes a prompt and a model into a chain?
questions.explanation: The pipe operator builds a Runnable sequence: the prompt output is passed to the model.

questions.title: This code raises an error. Why?
questions.codeSnippet:
prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    ("human", "Summarize: {text}"),
])
prompt.invoke({"content": "LangChain is a framework."})

options.text: The template needs a 'text' variable but the input provides 'content'
from_messages requires a system message
invoke() only accepts a string
Curly braces are not allowed in templates

questions.explanation: Every placeholder must be present in the input dict. The missing 'text' variable causes the error.

questions.title: Which are benefits of structured output compared with parsing free text yourself?

options.text: The result is validated against a schema
Downstream code receives typed fields instead of raw text
The extracted facts are guaranteed to be true
Field descriptions are no longer needed

questions.explanation: A schema guarantees shape, not truth. The model can still fill fields with wrong facts, and clear field descriptions still improve results.

questions.title: What does this code print?
questions.codeSnippet:
class Movie(BaseModel):
    title: str
    year: int

structured = model.with_structured_output(Movie)
movie = structured.invoke("Inception was released in 2010.")
print(movie.year + 1)

options.text: 2011, because movie is a Movie object and year is an int
A TypeError because year is a str
An AttributeError because movie is a dict
The class name Movie

questions.explanation: With a Pydantic schema the result is an instance of that class with validated, typed fields.

questions.title: What does prompt.invoke(...) return here?
questions.codeSnippet:
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate

prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    ("system", "Translate to {lang}."),
    ("human", "{text}"),
])
result = prompt.invoke({"lang": "French", "text": "Hi"})

options.text: A ChatPromptValue holding the formatted messages; no model is called
The French translation as a string
An AIMessage
A KeyError because lang is not defined

questions.explanation: A prompt template only formats input into messages. The model is called only when the prompt is piped into a chat model.

questions.title: What is the main purpose of model.with_structured_output(Schema)?

options.text: It makes the model respond to every request in JSON text that you parse manually
It returns output that has been parsed and validated into the given schema, such as a Pydantic object
It trains the model on your schema
It caches responses on disk

questions.explanation: with_structured_output wraps the model so that invoke() returns data matching the schema, removing manual parsing.
